description: This file defines a React component named DataTable that renders a data table with features such as sortable columns, pagination, dynamic column width calculation, and server-side data fetching support. It includes internal functions for measuring text width, handling sorting, pagination controls, and rendering table rows with optional edit/delete actions.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string using an off-screen canvas, with a fallback to character count if canvas is unavailable.

methods.name: DataTable
methods.description: Main React component that renders a data table with sorting, pagination, and dynamic column widths.
